const shareGrants = await db.accessGrant.findMany({ select: { id: true, scope: true, grantedAt: true } })
export function Ledger({ sharedPolicies }) {
    return (
        <ul>
            {sharedPolicies.map((sp) => (
                <li key={sp.grantId}>{sp.insurerName}</li>
            ))}
        </ul>
    )
}
export function Card({ policy }) {
    return <p>{policy.insurerName}</p>
}
